target.policy: Clean-room classification from public documentation, black-box oracle output, and OpenRSCAD's public implementation/tests; verified does not imply exhaustive input coverage.

hosts.lsp: Language server render and analysis paths

sources.description: Measured compatibility audit and execution plan

features.summary: Assignments, last-write-wins hoisting, dead RHS suppression, and no-forward-reference behavior match the oracle cases.
Conditional expressions and nesting are oracle-covered.
User module definition, lexical lookup, and invocation are exercised through observable echoes.
Named functions, recursion, mutual recursion, and calls are oracle-covered.
Function literals and calls through function values are oracle-covered.
Generic named and positional binding is implemented; only selected builtin signatures have direct oracle cases.

A $-prefixed argument is dynamically scoped over the callee and everything under it, for builtin modules, user modules and their children(), and function calls; each argument expression evaluates once in the caller's scope and does not leak past the call.

Omitted function and module defaults are lazy and use the definition's ordinary lexical environment, while special variables remain dynamic and explicit arguments use caller scope; these paths are oracle-covered.
Ordinary bindings and closures use lexical scope.
Special variables follow the dynamic call chain.
Statement-level conditional branching is parsed and evaluated; upstream diagnostic and edge parity are not inventoried.
Range/list and Cartesian statement iteration are implemented; exhaustive oracle coverage is pending.
Statement-level lexical bindings are implemented.

features.rationale: OpenRSCAD intentionally uses a deterministic xorshift generator; identical upstream pseudo-random values are not promised.

features.summary: Returns the declared compatibility baseline [2021, 1, 0]; no standalone oracle case is committed.
Two/three-component conversion and representative current-version input are oracle-covered.
Default/indexed lookup and nested user-module stack behavior are oracle-covered.
Angular fragment control participates in oracle-checked sphere tessellation.

Explicit fragment counts are oracle-covered across curved primitives and rotate_extrude.
Animation time overrides and frame sweeps are implemented; no upstream oracle sequence is committed.

features.surface: text() kerning, ligatures, and complex-script shaping
features.summary: Layout is codepoint-by-codepoint, without kerning, ligatures, or complex-script shaping.
RTL only reverses codepoints; vertical directions and meaningful language/script selection are absent.
Explicit height, centering, twist, scale, and slices have geometry oracles.
The OpenCSG preview hint is accepted but has no dedicated upstream preview oracle.
segments= subdivides each profile outline, applies without twist, and overrides $fn/$fa/$fs.
An omitted slice count takes the tighter of the $fa per-slice twist limit and the $fs helical-travel limit, or $fn slices per revolution.
A twisted profile outline is re-tessellated from $fn/$fa/$fs independently of the slice count, apportioning a per-contour segment budget across edges by length.
The non-planar wall quad follows the twist direction and contour winding, which is exact for profiles straddling the Z axis but still differs for off-axis (+1.3%) and holed (+0.6%) profiles.
Non-uniform scale refines the profile and adds slices upstream; OpenRSCAD refines only for twist, which is volume-neutral alone but differs by 0.8% combined with twist.
Negative height can produce reflected geometry rather than OpenSCAD's empty result.
Post-baseline oblique extrusion along a normalized direction has committed geometry oracles.
Full/partial sweeps, negative-side profiles, over-rotation, axis crossings, and partial fragment counts have geometry oracles.
The OpenCSG preview hint is accepted but has no dedicated upstream preview oracle.
Post-baseline start-angle rotation is implemented and invariant-tested; the selected upstream oracle predates the parameter.
Flat silhouette and Z=0 cut projection have geometry oracles, including nested 2D operations.
2D/3D vectors and named binding have geometry oracles.
Euler and axis-angle positional/named forms have geometry oracles.
Vector and scalar broadcast forms have geometry oracles.
Representative zero-dimension auto scaling has a geometry oracle.
The OpenCSG preview hint is accepted but has no dedicated upstream preview oracle.
Representative plane reflection has a geometry oracle.
Named matrix binding and affine shear have a geometry oracle.
CSS names, #rgb[a]/#rrggbb[aa], vectors, and alpha are implemented and locally tested; no upstream color oracle is committed.
Round/radial and delta/chamfer paths, explicit fragments, holes, concavity, and collapse cases have geometry oracles.
Overlapping, disjoint, coplanar, nested, and 2D unions have geometry oracles.
3D/2D difference and empty-tool behavior have geometry oracles.
Representative and empty intersections have geometry oracles.
2D and multiple 3D hull configurations have geometry oracles.

features.surface: minkowski() for 2D, convex 3D, and unions of convex parts
features.summary: 2D sums, convex 3D sums, and distribution over explicit unions have geometry oracles.

features.surface: minkowski() with a genuinely concave 3D leaf
features.summary: A concave leaf is replaced by its convex hull, with a runtime warning; explicit unions of convex parts remain exact.
The child passes through the exact rendering pipeline; convexity is accepted as a preview hint, without an upstream render-boundary oracle.
Child grouping is implemented as a transparent geometry group.
Named/scalar/list/string formatting and child pass-through are exercised throughout the echo oracle suite.
Passing/failing assertions and child pass-through are implemented and broadly exercised by BOSL2, without a standalone upstream diagnostic oracle.
Child capture, forwarding, and indexed selection are locally tested; geometry output lacks a dedicated upstream oracle.
The retained deprecated singular child alias is not implemented.
Included definitions, assignments, and side effects have an echo oracle.
Definition-only loading and suppression of assignments/side effects have an echo oracle.

features.surface: include/use paths with spaces and punctuation
features.summary: Angle-bracket contents are preserved from raw source; focused parser/resolver tests exist but no standalone upstream oracle case is committed.
Nested files resolve relative to their containing file; native and virtual resolvers implement the same evaluator contract.
Native resolvers search OPENSCADPATH after the containing directory; browser hosts instead use their project/library registry.
Representative STL mesh import has a geometry oracle.
Representative OFF mesh import has a geometry oracle.
Plain AMF vertices/triangles are parsed, without a committed upstream geometry fixture.
A representative compressed 3MF mesh has a geometry oracle.
The OpenCSG preview hint is accepted but has no dedicated upstream preview oracle.
OBJ vertex/face import is implemented and fuzzed; its upstream introduction/version and complete syntax are not oracle-classified here.
A representative simple 2D DXF import has an extrusion-based geometry oracle.
The layer selector is accepted but ignored, importing all supported entities.
Documented DXF origin/scale transforms are accepted but ignored.

features.surface: DXF bulges, splines, ellipses, and fragment controls
features.summary: The parser handles a useful line/arc/polyline subset; documented curve families and caller resolution controls remain incomplete.
A representative basic SVG path import has an extrusion-based geometry oracle.
SVG element/group selectors are accepted but ignored.

features.surface: SVG transforms, dimensions, units, and DPI options
features.summary: Basic physical sizing exists, but import parameters and general nested element transforms are incomplete.

features.surface: SVG nesting, use, style, and visibility
features.summary: Nested scene structure, use references, inherited styles, and visibility semantics are incomplete.

features.surface: AMF/3MF units, objects, components, and build transforms
features.summary: Import flattens XML tags rather than assembling complete per-object scene graphs, so units, independent index spaces, components, and build-item transforms can be wrong.
The retained deprecated alias is not implemented.
The retained deprecated alias is not implemented.
The retained deprecated DXF dimension function is not implemented.
The retained deprecated DXF cross-point function is not implemented.
Whitespace heightmaps have a committed geometry oracle.
DAT centering is implemented and convexity is accepted as a preview hint; neither has a dedicated upstream oracle case.
PNG luminance heightmaps, centering, and inversion are locally tested; no OpenSCAD-derived geometry golden is committed.
Binary and ASCII STL serialization is implemented and locally round-trip tested; byte identity is outside the compatibility contract.
OFF serialization is implemented; color-aware preview output uses compatible extensions where applicable.
Basic AMF mesh serialization is implemented.
3MF package serialization and color groups are implemented and locally integration-tested.
Kernel-aware contour export is wired across first-party hosts; 2D output bytes are not yet upstream-oracle gated.
Kernel-aware contour export is wired across first-party hosts; 2D output bytes are not yet upstream-oracle gated.
Raster rendering, camera, projection, and image sizing are implemented; GUI/raster pixel parity is outside the core language criterion.
OpenSCAD-style .csg serialization is not implemented; the CLI silently writes binary STL to a .csg path instead of failing.
An unrecognized -o suffix silently falls back to binary STL and exits 0; OpenSCAD rejects an invalid suffix and asks for --export-format.
